EXAM MECHANICS CONFIRMED (not hedged): NY DMV's official page (dmv.ny.gov/driver-license/get-a-motorcycle-learner-permit-and-license) states the Class M written/knowledge test has 20 multiple-choice questions, requires at least 14 correct (70%) to pass, AND requires at least 2 of the 4 road-sign questions correct as a separate sub-requirement. Per preliminary research, NY's written knowledge test is NOT broadly waived by course completion -- the MSF Basic RiderCourse waiver (manual, 'Waiver of Skills Test') applies only to the on-cycle ROAD/SKILLS test, not the written knowledge test, which remains mandatory for all standard-path applicants.
